# Electrical Spectrum Analyzer

`maiman.components.ElectricalSpectrumAnalyzer` · category **Measurements** · [all components](index.md)

Power against frequency of an electrical signal, into a matched load.

The waveform is taken as a voltage across `load` or a current into it,
whichever its unit says, and the one-sided power spectrum is computed from
one FFT of the whole window, with no taper: tones from an `RFTone`
sit on the FFT's grid and land in single bins. Each displayed point is then
the power summed over `resolution_bandwidth` around it. DC is left out of
the display; it is a bias, not a signal.

## Ports

| Port | Direction | Type |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `in` | input | electrical |
| `out` | output | metric |

## Parameters

| Parameter | Default | Unit | Range | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `resolution_bandwidth` | `1.0` | MHz | 0.0 …  | Width each point sums over; at least one FFT bin |
| `stop` | `0.0` | GHz | 0.0 …  | Highest frequency shown; 0 shows up to Nyquist |
| `load` | `50.0` | ohm | 0.001 …  | Load resistance |
